messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about HISTORY in German Reich (1871-1945) during the 1870s and 1880s and 1890s and 1900s and 1910s, matching this research need: Historical German money and capital market time series, 1871–1914, with interest rates, stock prices, income returns, and regional stock exchange data across major financial centers and industries before World War I.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
